title: Replace deprecated Lightstep and Opencensus telemetry providers

detection.reason: The note does not identify a single cluster-inventory field for telemetry provider configuration; provider settings may be in Telemetry resources, mesh configuration, or external configuration.

quote: - **Upcoming deprecation of telemetry providers** — The telemetry providers Lightstep and Opencensus are deprecated and will be removed in next release(v1.27). Please consider using the OpenTelemetry provider instead.
remediation: Replace the Lightstep and Opencensus telemetry providers with the OpenTelemetry provider before upgrading to the release that removes them.
verifyCommand: kubectl get telemetry --all-namespaces -o yaml | grep -iE 'lightstep|opencensus' # matching Telemetry objects may use deprecated providers; no match does not rule out mesh or external configuration

title: Verify ztunnel resource names remain synchronized with Istiod

detection.reason: The affected Helm resourceName value and whether it is kept in sync with the Istiod Helm chart are not represented by a single cluster-inventory field.

quote: - **Ztunnel Helm chart changes** — In Istio 1.25, the resources in the ztunnel Helm chart were changed to be named `.Resource.Name`. This often caused issues, as the name needs to be kept in sync with the Istiod Helm chart. In this release, we have reverted to default to a static `ztunnel` name again. As previously, this can be overriden with `--set resourceName=my-custom-name`.
remediation: Verify that the ztunnel resources use the static `ztunnel` name by default, or that the custom `--set resourceName=my-custom-name` value is kept in sync with the Istiod Helm chart.
verifyCommand: kubectl get daemonsets,deployments,services -A -o yaml | grep -i ztunnel # matching resources are candidates for manual verification against the Istiod resource name and Helm resourceName setting
